# What do you really make on a dozen eggs?

> Free calculator for backyard egg sellers: what a dozen eggs costs you, how many hours it takes, your profit per dozen and per hour, the price per dozen you need to earn a wage, and what feed cost and winter lay rate do to it. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages
